coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of 5 variable items at a conceptual level (20%): trajectory type, comparing ground-truth, subsampled, and MDGEN-generated trajectories. The specified constants and dependent-variable definitions are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 10 fs rather than 100 fs ground-truth and generated resolution, and introduces multiple subsampling intervals instead of the fixed 10 ps comparison. Omits pooling 30k test-peptide frames and the fixed training/inference settings (256-residue crops, every-40-frame sampling, full-protein inference). Replaces cosine-difference torsion autocorrelation with normalized angular covariance, omits the 100 fs–100 ps lag range, and does not measure dynamic content as the negative derivative with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected conclusions: recovery of sub-ps oscillations, close agreement with ground-truth autocorrelation, non-monotonic dynamic content indicating fast relaxation recovery, and the absence of these features in subsampled trajectories.
